title: fix(objectql)!: under strictReadonlyWrites, a write whose value a stored expression replaces is refused, and nothing is written
body:
Closes #25000
Clause-②: no (narrowing: under `strictReadonlyWrites`, a write whose value a stored expression replaces is refused instead of reported; it ships now under the amended 「甲」, #6015 `6303865025`)

## What changes

`strictReadonlyWrites` refuses every drop that `onFieldsDropped` reports. Since the `stored_expression` reason landed (#24690, PR #24778 `7532ea3c08`), one reported drop was left out of the refusal: a caller value for a stored (non-`formula`) field that declares an `expression`, which the engine replaces with the computed value. Under strict such a write completed and was only reported. The amended ruling 「甲」 (#6015 `6303865025`) ships the refusal in 18.x as a BREAKING minor, and triage re-timed this card to 18.x (`6305854988`).

- **Insert (single, batch, `insertMany`).** The strict check in `engine.insert` now judges `insertDrops`, the one event list that includes the stored-expression replacement, after the compute pass. Before, it judged only the strips' drops, ahead of that pass. A replaced value throws `ReadonlyFieldRejectedError` (`operation: 'insert'`) before validation and before any driver dispatch, and no listener fires. `insertMany` delegates to `insert`, so it refuses the whole call, as it does for the other strict drops.
- **Update by id and predicate update.** The `stored_expression` report now goes through `emitDrop`, the channel every strip reports through, and no longer calls `notifyDrop` directly. On both branches the one `assertNoStrictDrops()` call now comes after the stored-expression pass. So under strict the write is refused before the statement and nothing is written. An object that declares no stored expression skips that pass, so its refusal happens exactly where it did before.
- **One refusal names everything.** A payload that carries another strip's drop as well as a replaced value is now refused once, naming both, with `stored_expression` last. Before, it was refused for the other drop alone.
- **Wording.** `REASON_PHRASE.stored_expression` (written by #24690 ahead of this refusal) is reused. The per-reason message gains a `stored_expression` remedy (leave the field out, or send the computed value). That remedy is spoken only when the reason is present, so every other refusal's message is unchanged byte for byte, by the same rule the `computed` remedy follows.
- **Docs.** The TSDoc in `packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts` (`strictReadonlyWrites`) and `packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts` (`DroppedFieldsEvent.reason`) no longer names `stored_expression` as the arm strict does not refuse. The objectql comments in `engine.ts` and `readonly-strict-errors.ts` follow. No `.describe()` text moved: `check:generated` reports all 14 artifacts current, so the generated reference docs have nothing to regenerate.

**Unchanged:** a strict write that sends the computed value, or no value, is not refused. A stored expression field that is also `readonly` is still refused once, as `readonly`. Without strict, the write completes with the computed value and is reported. The error code is unchanged.

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/engine-stored-expression-dropped-fields.test.ts`: the strict block changes from "reported, not refused" to "refused, nothing written". It covers update by id, insert single, batch, `insertMany` and predicate update. Each refusal asserts the `code`, `drops` (and `operation`/`fields` where they matter), that the store is unchanged, and that the listener stayed silent. A non-strict control sits beside each refusal (the write succeeds and is reported), together with the strict controls for "computed value sent / no value". The union case is also covered (`readonly_when` + `stored_expression` in one refusal), and so is the `readonly`-only insert refusal.

All runs were taken on the final code commit `a8e9d3611c`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 455 files / 8569 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit` clean, and `check:test-typecheck` OK (ledger held).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date. `spec test`: 705 files / 21424 passed (1 todo). `spec typecheck`: OK. `spec test:repo`: 72 files / 1237 passed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 94 commands from merge base `688052e14`, and all 94 exited 0. On the first pass, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` printed PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3, nothing measured). I re-ran `check:type-check-debt` under the verify lock: its closure build ran and it re-measured OK, `none above its recorded number`. That full build also produced the missing `dist/` trees, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` then passed (112 entry points across 69 packages load). `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles 94 derived, 94 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The changeset gates are among the 94: `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`.

**Ablation.** The fix was committed first. Each leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with an anchor hit of 1 to 0 and the blob proven back to the HEAD blob `3e8c0ec2bd1a` with `git diff HEAD` empty. The suite imports `./engine.js` from source, so no build is involved.

- A, update paths: `emitDrop` lets `stored_expression` past strict. Three tests go red (update by id, predicate update, the union case), and the other 22 stay green.
- B, insert: the strict check ignores a `stored_expression`-only list. Three tests go red (insert single, batch, `insertMany`), and the other 22 stay green.

## Producers measured

No non-test caller in this repository passes `strictReadonlyWrites`: the examples, `packages/qa` dogfood and the runtime and REST doors pass none. The option is also not on the serializable options bag, so no wire caller can set it. No in-repo producer moves. In the objectql suite, the in-package strict tests on stored-expression objects (`engine-stored-expression-write.test.ts`, `engine-write-formula-hydration.test.ts`, `engine-formula-write-strip.test.ts`) stay green unchanged.

## Changeset

`.changeset/25000-strict-stored-expression-refusal.md`: `@objectstack/objectql` `minor`, with a BREAKING section that maps FROM (completed, reported) TO (refused, nothing written), gives the remedy, and carries the claim's `Clause-②` line and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker (the precedent shape of `bb4f5cc005`). `@objectstack/spec` is not listed: only TSDoc comments moved there, and no `.describe()` text or export did.

## Acceptance notes

- The release-owned 18.x upgrade checklist (`content/docs/releases/`) is not edited here. The changeset carries the text that release compilation reads.
- The pending `.changeset/24690-stored-expression-dropped-fields.md` (in the open Version Packages PR) says strict "is unchanged" and that the refusal is deferred to 19.0. That file is outside this card's claimed file surface, so this PR leaves it alone. The new changeset says it supersedes that bullet. The report names the one-line amendment for the seat to decide.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx` (the `expression` on a stored field paragraph) still says a sent value is "not reported as dropped", which has been false since #24690. That is a hand-written doc outside this card's surface, and it is noted in the report.

Open PRs touching the same files were checked: #25072 and #24893 edit `engine.ts` in disjoint hunks (lines 4628–6300 and 9043–12250). No open PR touches `data-engine.zod.ts`, `contracts/data-engine.ts` or `readonly-strict-errors.ts`.
